discovery_notes: WDW 2016 OE backfill; 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet, mostly Disney Pins Blog. 2017-dated pins released Dec 2016 are in packet 217 and not duplicated. Birthstone pins split one per month as DPB names a character per month. Humphrey/20,000 Leagues/Mary Poppins are preview announcements only. Several Disney Parks releases shared DLR/WDW. Set member lists from resellers recorded only as not_found leads.
